python -c "
import parse
import pickle

print('=== R4: FixedTzOffset timezone parsing ===')
# Test various timezone offset formats
patterns = [
    ('{d:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M%z}', '2023-01-15T10:30+5'),
    ('{d:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M%z}', '2023-01-15T10:30+05'),
    ('{d:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M%z}', '2023-01-15T10:30+0530'),
    ('{d:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M%z}', '2023-01-15T10:30+5:30'),
]
for pat, text in patterns:
    r = parse.Parser(pat).search(text)
    if r:
        print(f'  {text} -> tz={r[\"d\"].tzinfo}')
    else:
        print(f'  {text} -> FAILED')

print()
print('=== R5: Fortran float type F ===')
p = parse.Parser('{value:F}')
result = p.search('123.456')
print(f'  {{value:F}} on \"123.456\": {result}')
if result:
    print(f'  Value: {result[\"value\"]}, type: {type(result[\"value\"]).__name__}')

print()
print('=== R6: Hexadecimal, binary, octal integers ===')
# Decimal with base detection
p1 = parse.Parser('{val:d}')
r1 = p1.search('0xFF')
print(f'  {{val:d}} on \"0xFF\": {r1}')
if r1:
    print(f'    Value: {r1[\"val\"]} (should be 255)')

# Binary
r2 = p1.search('0b1010')
print(f'  {{val:d}} on \"0b1010\": {r2}')
if r2:
    print(f'    Value: {r2[\"val\"]} (should be 10)')

# Octal  
r3 = p1.search('0o77')
print(f'  {{val:d}} on \"0o77\": {r3}')
if r3:
    print(f'    Value: {r3[\"val\"]} (should be 63)')

# Explicit types
p2 = parse.Parser('{hex:x}')
r4 = p2.search('FF')
print(f'  {{hex:x}} on \"FF\": {r4}')
if r4:
    print(f'    Value: {r4[\"hex\"]} (should be 255)')

p3 = parse.Parser('{bin:b}')
r5 = p3.search('1010')
print(f'  {{bin:b}} on \"1010\": {r5}')
if r5:
    print(f'    Value: {r5[\"bin\"]} (should be 10)')

p4 = parse.Parser('{oct:o}')
r6 = p4.search('77')
print(f'  {{oct:o}} on \"77\": {r6}')
if r6:
    print(f'    Value: {r6[\"oct\"]} (should be 63)')
" 2>/dev/null
